name: Email Verification Rejected
summary: An unverified durable user receives a verification code, submits proof that cannot be accepted, and remains unverified on the code-entry surface with a deterministic rejected presentation state.
finalOutcome: Email ownership remains unverified and the current verification attempt is rejected without exposing the internal rejection reason.

sourceReferences.note: Mismatched, malformed, expired, consumed, and exhausted proof are rejection permutations rather than separate behaviors. The same code-entry screen may render a rejected View State.
